title: How ADT is reaching the next generation of homeowners through creators on TikTok
summary: At Advertising Week New York, ADT's CMO Kim Miller shared how creator-led storytelling on TikTok drove an 89% increase in website clicks.
body_markdown:
Kim Miller, right, recently discussed ADT marketing strategy on the Great Minds Stage at Advertising Week New York in October.


ADT is partnering with creators on TikTok to connect with more homeowners and renters. The strategy is rooted in a simple insight: People trust people.


“When we survey home security buyers, 68% say a peer’s voice matters most in their purchase decision," said[Kim Miller](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kim-miller/) , ADT’s Chief Marketing and Communications Officer. "That’s the power of creators and communities. They humanize the brand through genuine recommendations. And what’s more trusted than that?”


That insight prompted ADT to rethink its TikTok ad content, shifting from adapting traditional ads to building creator-led stories around familiar life moments. Videos focused on moving into a first home, starting a family or living independently for the first time. Audience insights from[TikTok Market Scope](https://marketscope.tiktok.com/) helped identify the topics and formats most likely to connect with viewers.


Check out ADT on TikTok to see how influencers are using their systems.


[ADT (@adt) | TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@adt/video/7691400904095894797)


The results have spoken for themselves. The posts held attention, reached new audiences and translated that interest into website visits, showing that more relatable storytelling could support awareness and business goals.


#### By the numbers


- **89% more website clicks**


- **32% more people reached**


- **22% lower cost to generate a potential customer**


- **Creator videos held attention nearly 10 times better** than repurposed TV ads.


Miller discussed the strategy on the[Great Minds Stage at Advertising Week New York](https://newyork2026.advertisingweek.com/aw/schedule/stage/-great-minds) on Oct. 6 during “Know Where Your Audience Is Going Next,” alongside Catherine Salazar, Global Head of Agencies at TikTok, and Kate Black, Executive Vice President of Performance Media at Horizon Next.


For ADT, the opportunity is bigger than a single campaign. The brand will continue pairing its known professional monitoring expertise with relatable creator voices to reach potential customers earlier, introduce new products and build understanding.


“Consumer behavior will keep changing, and we’ll evolve with it by meeting people where they are and showing up in the moments that matter to them,” Miller said.
